title: Up to 10 years of tax relief? Not for every business.

lines: Up to ten years of tax relief?
For qualifying investments, potentially. For every business, no.
In El Salvador, this regime covers new investments in San Salvador's defined Historic Center.
Investment: an eligible activity, above the minimum.
Approval: qualified by the Planning Authority.
Then: who receives it? A landlord's approval doesn't automatically cut a tenant's taxes.
Subscribe to Aurora for the next breakdown: who actually gets the benefit — owner, operator, or developer.
